text:
Hiring for several roles at StudyTurtle, an edutainment brand building learning videos for Education. Our small, passionate team creates animated shows for kids (ages 4-10) and we create our own tools to create the show faster. We want to help kids fall in love with curiosity and real-world learning. We use custom automation to speed up everything from story writing to animation. See what we’re making: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c46VaM_VZGU

Open Roles (REMOTE, non US): Animators (2D/3D or hybrid—experience with AI tools a plus) Director/Writer - Writer and storyboarder, good at storyboarding, storytelling, writing, and prompting Computer vision engineer - Must have deep experience with SVG programming and/or computer vision

Why join us? -Fully remote, async-friendly Ship real things that impact how kids learn Fast, creative, zero-corporate-BS environment Must have at least 3+ hours overlap with PST hours. -Direct access to founders; real ownership -Opportunity to shape our tools and shows from the ground up

To apply: Email jobs [at] studyturtle.com with your background, a few sentences about why edtech is important to you, any feedback on our episodes, and why this mission excites you. Take a look at the episode we posted and give us feedback on how you would make it better. Please include links to any relevant work.

We are the hiring company and will reply to all genuine applicants. No recruiters, no agencies, please.

Genre, co-creator StudyTurtle
